fish.blurb: An enormous-headed filter feeder that hangs in the green water like a sunken lantern.

fish.name: Golden Mahseer
fish.blurb: The tiger of the river, armoured in gold coin scales. Its first run has broken more rods than any rock.

fish.name: Giant Snakehead
fish.blurb: A red-striped ambusher that guards the temple doorways and strikes at anything that moves.

fish.name: Asian Arowana
fish.blurb: The dragon fish of the old emperors, scales edged in red gold. Leaps clear of the water for falling insects.

fish.name: Black Carp
fish.blurb: A coal-dark carp that crushes snails with teeth in its throat. It lives at the foot of the deepest stair.

fish.name: Mekong Giant Catfish
fish.blurb: A toothless grey giant as long as a boat, said to carry the souls of drowned monks. It takes an hour to raise.

fish.name: Temple Bell Carp
fish.blurb: A carp so vast the monks once hung a bronze bell from its fin. On still nights you can still hear it ring under the water.

fish.name: The Jade Sovereign
fish.blurb: A colossal arowana with scales of living jade, older than the temple itself. When it leaps, the whole lake goes quiet and the stone faces seem to watch.

fish.name: The Naga of the Steps
fish.blurb: A serpent-long giant snakehead with seven red bands, coiled around the sunken stairway. The old carvings on the walls are of this fish.

fish.name: Sablefish
fish.blurb: A soot-black cod of the warm vents, oily and rich enough to fry in its own fat.

fish.name: Blackbelly Rosefish
fish.blurb: A red, spiny scorpionfish that rests on the ash slopes with its mouth open.

fish.name: Ashfin Cusk-eel
fish.blurb: A grey, eel-like fish that burrows in warm volcanic sand and wriggles out at the scent of bait.

fish.name: Pumice Lizardfish
fish.blurb: A long-jawed ambusher that lies buried in pumice gravel with only its eyes showing.

fish.name: Orange Roughy
fish.blurb: A deep-red fish that can live for two hundred years in the cold beside the hot vents.

fish.name: Basalt Rockfish
fish.blurb: Mottled grey and black like cooled lava. It dives straight back into its crack when hooked.

fish.name: Ember Lanternshark
fish.blurb: A small shark with a glowing orange belly that hides its silhouette against the vent light.

fish.name: Vent Hagfish
fish.blurb: A slimy, eyeless scavenger that ties itself in knots to escape. Your landing net will never be clean again.

fish.name: Frilled Shark
fish.blurb: A living fossil with an eel's body and three hundred trident-shaped teeth. Its gills ruffle like a collar.

fish.name: Pacific Halibut
fish.blurb: A flatfish the size of a barn door that lies flat on the trench floor and rises like a lid.

fish.name: Magma Tilefish
fish.blurb: Banded gold and red, it digs burrows in the warm ash and bolts for them at the first pull.

fish.name: Smalltooth Sand Tiger
fish.blurb: A heavy, spotted deep-water shark with a mouth full of crooked needle teeth.

fish.name: Obsidian Chimaera
fish.blurb: A ghost shark with skin like black glass and huge green eyes. It flaps through the dark like a bird.

fish.name: Ocean Sunfish
fish.blurb: A giant round fish that looks like a head with no body. It rises to bask in the warm vent water.

fish.name: Cinderjaw Moray
fish.blurb: A huge moray with scorched-orange jaws that lives inside a still-warm lava tube.

fish.name: Great White Shark
fish.blurb: The ocean's most feared hunter, drawn to the trench by the warm water. It circles the boat before it bites.

fish.name: Tiger Shark
fish.blurb: A striped garbage-gut of the deep that will eat anything, including your other fish.

fish.name: Warsaw Grouper
fish.blurb: A dark, ancient grouper that lives in the cooled lava caves and swallows sharks whole.

fish.name: The Last Megalodon
fish.blurb: A shark the size of a whale that should have died out millions of years ago. The vents kept it warm. Its teeth are as big as your hand.

fish.name: The Caldera Wyrm
fish.blurb: A twelve-metre frilled giant with a glowing red throat, born in the heart of the undersea volcano. Sailors say the water boils where it surfaces.

fish.name: Reed King Wels
fish.blurb: A wels catfish that has eaten every duck the village ever lost.

fish.name: Riverlord Taimen
fish.blurb: The great salmonid of the upper river. Takes a whole pool to turn.

fish.name: Greyfell Lake Sturgeon
fish.blurb: Older than the boathouse. Rises once a decade.

fish.name: Goliath Grouper
fish.blurb: Sits in the channel mouth like a sunken barrel and swallows the tide.

fish.name: Harrow Swordfish
fish.blurb: Runs the kelp gullies at dusk with a blade the length of a man.

fish.name: Giant Trevally
fish.blurb: The reef bully. Hits like a dropped anvil and never stops.

fish.name: Blackwater Goonch
fish.blurb: A devil catfish of the dark roots. The villagers do not swim here.

fish.name: Old Reach Wolffish
fish.blurb: Teeth like a smith's tongs. Bites the ice-hole rim on the way up.

fish.name: Giant Oarfish
fish.blurb: The sailors' sea serpent, ribbon-bodied and eleven metres long.

fish.name: The Mill Giant
fish.blurb: A Siamese giant barb, the largest carp-like fish on earth, with scales the size of saucers. A sailor brought it home as a fingerling eighty years ago and tipped it in the millpond.

fish.name: The Last Paddlefish
fish.blurb: A Chinese paddlefish, seven metres of grey-blue body behind a sword of a snout. Declared extinct from every river in the world. Every river but this one.

fish.name: The Greyfell Perch
fish.blurb: A Nile perch of impossible size, silver-grey with a black eye ringed in gold. It took the lake in a single generation and now nothing else grows old here.

fish.name: The Channel Hammer
fish.blurb: A great hammerhead that patrols the estuary mouth on the flood tide. Its dorsal fin stands a metre clear of the water and the wading birds go silent.

fish.name: The Grey Pilgrim
fish.blurb: A basking shark that appears off the Point once a generation, mouth wide, drifting through the plankton like a slow grey cathedral.

fish.name: The Sunfire Manta
fish.blurb: A giant oceanic manta with a seven-metre span, its back lit gold by the drop-off light. It breaches at dusk and the whole reef hears it land.

fish.name: The Fanged Warden
fish.blurb: A goliath tigerfish, thirty-two teeth like a dog's and eyes that catch the lamp. The villagers do not swim here, and this is why.

fish.name: The Ice Sleeper
fish.blurb: A Pacific sleeper shark, seven metres of slate-grey muscle that rises under the ice-hole without a sound. It has never been in a hurry.

fish.name: The Hadal Wanderer
fish.blurb: A whale shark, the largest fish that has ever lived, spotted like a night sky. It passes through the Deep once a year and the sea goes dark beneath the boat.

fish.name: The Stone Lamprey
fish.blurb: A pale, eyeless lamprey four metres long, older than the fungus light. It fastens to the rock and waits, and it has been waiting a very long time.

fish.name: Gourdfin Sunfish
fish.blurb: A sunfish with a pumpkin-orange belly and ribs that glow like a carved grin.

fish.name: Candlewick Minnow
fish.blurb: Its tail flickers like a candle flame. Shoals of them light the shallows on autumn nights.

fish.name: Cobweb Carp
fish.blurb: Fine grey threads trail from its fins like old cobwebs. Smells faintly of attic dust.

fish.name: Bone Perch
fish.blurb: Pale stripes over a near-transparent body. You can count its bones by lantern light.

fish.name: Witch's Eel
fish.blurb: Black as a cauldron and twice as slippery. Old wives say it knows your name.

fish.name: Lantern-Jaw Pike
fish.blurb: A pike with a jaw that glows orange from within, like a jack-o'-lantern with teeth.

fish.name: Graveyard Gar
fish.blurb: Grey-green and tombstone-still until it strikes. Found wherever old willows lean over water.

fish.name: Hexscale Koi
fish.blurb: Every scale carries a tiny violet sigil. Nobody has managed to read them twice the same.

fish.name: Moonlit Wraithfish
fish.blurb: Half there, half not. It casts no shadow under the full moon.

fish.name: The Headless Haddock
fish.blurb: It has no head and it still bites. Do not ask how.

fish.name: The Pumpkin King Carp
fish.blurb: A colossal carp, round and orange as a prize pumpkin, crowned with a stalk-like dorsal fin.

fish.name: The Banshee of the Shallows
fish.blurb: A pale, long-finned phantom fish whose wail carries across every water on Halloween night.

fish.name: Starlight Ray
fish.blurb: A ray whose back mirrors the night sky. Seen only when the stars are out.

fish.name: Dawnfire Carp
fish.blurb: Scales the colour of the first light. It rises with the sun and is gone by breakfast.

fish.name: Vesper Eel
fish.blurb: Hunts the mangrove channels in the half hour of red light, then sinks into the mud.

fish.name: Islet Rudd
fish.blurb: A bright little rudd with blood-red fins. The first fish every crew tips into its pond.

fish.name: Rope-Striped Bream
fish.blurb: A bronze bream with a navy stripe down its side, like a mooring line.

fish.name: Lantern Goldfish
fish.blurb: Its veil tail glows warm orange at dusk, like a paper lantern on the clubhouse porch.

fish.name: Captain's Koi
fish.blurb: A white and red koi with a black patch shaped exactly like a captain's cap.

fish.name: Deckhand Tench
fish.blurb: An olive tench that works the pond floor all day without a single complaint.

fish.name: Pennant Trout
fish.blurb: A rainbow trout whose dorsal fin flies like a crew's red and white pennant.

fish.name: Brass-Scaled Carp
fish.blurb: A mirror carp with scales like polished ship's brass. The crew polishes the pond rails to match.

fish.name: Moonpool Sturgeon
fish.blurb: A pale sturgeon marked with crescent moons. It only rises when the island is quiet.

fish.name: The Commodore
fish.blurb: A vast old catfish with a moustache of white whiskers. It has outranked every captain the crew ever had.

fish.name: Crown Koi of the Crew
fish.blurb: A pearl and gold koi with a glowing crown crest. Only the proudest crews ever see it leap.

rods.name: Cane Pole
rods.desc: A bamboo pole and a prayer.

rods.name: Fibreglass Rod
rods.desc: Forgiving and tough.

rods.name: Graphite Spinning Rod
rods.desc: Light, sensitive, quick.

rods.name: Heavy Surf Rod
rods.desc: Built for the breakers.

rods.name: Carbon Match Rod
rods.desc: Tournament-grade carbon.

rods.name: Offshore Trolling Rod
rods.desc: Roller guides, gimbal butt.

rods.name: Deepwater Composite
rods.desc: Bends double and never breaks.

rods.name: Master's Heirloom Rod
rods.desc: Passed down four generations of legends.

rods.name: Titan Stand-Up Rod
rods.desc: Bent-butt, unbreakable. Built for fish that should not exist.

rods.name: Riverkeeper's Willow Rod
rods.desc: Cut from the oldest willow on the river. Bends like water.

rods.name: Stormbreaker Rod
rods.desc: Forged for the anglers who fish through gales.

rods.name: Leviathan Gaff Rod
rods.desc: Bone-white and heavy. Made for things that pull back.

rods.name: Hexwood Rod
rods.perk: Hex Hook: 8% of the fish you land bring a twin of the same species, in every water, all year. Never wears out.
rods.desc: Carved from a lightning-struck witch elm. Hex Hook: 8% of the fish you land bring a twin of the same species with them, in every water, all year. Never wears out. Only from the Marsh Witch at Halloween, or from another angler on the Market.

rods.name: Shoalcaller Rod
rods.perk: Shoal Call: +6% bite chance on every cast.
rods.desc: Strung with shells that hum under the water. Shoals turn towards it.

rods.name: Fellowship Ash Rod
rods.perk: Fellowship: +15% XP from every fish you land.
rods.desc: Five ribbons, one for each friend who stood on the bank beside you.

rods.name: Duelist's Rapier Rod
rods.perk: Quickdraw: 10% of your casts cost no energy.
rods.desc: A swept hilt for a grip. Fast, cruel and only handed to proven duellists.

rods.name: Giantsbane Rod
rods.perk: Giant Catch: every fish you land weighs 15% more, so it is worth more and can break records.
rods.desc: Iron and leviathan bone, studded with the teeth of things it brought in.

rods.name: Eternal Tide Rod
rods.perk: Eternal Tide: 6% of landed fish bring a twin, +10% XP from every catch, never wears out.
rods.desc: Coral that never stopped growing, wound with a tide that never went out. The rod of a lifetime.

rods.name: Drowned King's Rod
rods.desc: Raised from the Sunken Deep, still dripping. Nothing pulls harder.

rods.name: Reefsong Coral Rod
rods.perk: Reef Song: +5% bite chance and +2 luck on every cast.
rods.desc: Living coral grown around a whalebone core. Reef fish swear it sings.

rods.name: Moonreed Rod
rods.perk: Moonlit: +12% XP from every fish and 5% of casts cost no energy.
rods.desc: A single reed cut under a full moon, silvered with its light.

rods.name: Tempest Fang Rod
rods.perk: Stormcharged: 10% of casts cost no energy, fish weigh 8% more, never wears out.
rods.desc: A shark's fang set in storm-forged steel. Lightning still crawls along it.

rods.name: Emerald Wyrm Rod
rods.perk: Wyrmscale: +4 luck, fish weigh 12% more, +10% XP, never wears out.
rods.desc: Carved from jade that glows like a sea-dragon's eye. Fish feel it before they see it.

rods.name: Starfall Rod
rods.perk: Falling Star: 10% of landed fish bring a twin, +15% XP, 6% free casts, never wears out.
rods.desc: The night sky poured into a rod. A comet still trails the line.

rods.name: Abyssal Crown Rod
rods.perk: Crown of the Deep: 15% twin catches, fish weigh 20% more, +20% XP, +6 luck, +6% bite, 8% free casts, never wears out.
rods.desc: The crown of a drowned sea-king, fused to obsidian. The rarest rod in the Lands.

reels.name: Deepwater Lever Drag
reels.desc: Carbon washers the size of saucers.

reels.name: Master's Heirloom Reel
reels.desc: Brass and steel, kept oiled for eighty years.

reels.name: Titan Electric Winch
reels.desc: Geared like a ship's capstan. Hauls the deep up to the light.

reels.name: Brass Fly Reel
reels.desc: Old brass, new bearings. Sings when a fish runs.

reels.name: Harpooner's Winch
reels.desc: Salvaged whaling gear, geared for brutes.

reels.name: Abyssal Lever Drag
reels.desc: Sealed against a pressure no angler has felt.

reels.name: Drowned King's Winch
reels.desc: Raised beside the rod, barnacled and turning still. It never tires.

lines.name: Cotton Line
lines.desc: Snaps if you look at it wrong.

lines.name: Hollow-Core Braid
lines.desc: Spliced, not knotted. No weak point anywhere.

lines.name: Master's Heirloom Line
lines.desc: Silk-steel weave, spun by hand for one family.

lines.name: Titan Cable Braid
lines.desc: Rated for things measured in tonnes.

lines.name: Waxed Silk Line
lines.desc: Hand-waxed by the dockside widows. Forgiving.

lines.name: Deep-Sea Dyneema
lines.desc: Thinner than a hair, stronger than the wire.

lines.name: Leviathan Sinew
lines.desc: Cured tendon of something enormous. It does not snap.

lines.name: Drowned King's Line
lines.desc: Woven from the anchor rope of a ship that never surfaced.

baits.name: Bread Crust
baits.desc: Cheap and cheerful for pond fish.

baits.name: Earthworms
baits.desc: The universal freshwater bait.

baits.name: Maggots
baits.desc: Wriggly and irresistible to small fish.

baits.name: Live Minnows
baits.desc: For predators. Pike, bass, zander.

baits.name: Peeled Shrimp
baits.desc: Estuary and reef favourite.

baits.name: Squid Strips
baits.desc: Tough, smelly, sea-fish magnet.

baits.name: Spinner Lure
baits.desc: Flash and vibration for hunters.

baits.name: Cut Bait
baits.desc: Chunks of oily fish for big mouths.

baits.name: Live Bait
baits.desc: Small fish you caught yourself. Predators love it.

baits.name: Premium Chum
baits.desc: Draws in the rare and the ravenous.

baits.name: Glow Jig
baits.desc: Bioluminescent jig for the deep and dark.

baits.name: Crickets
baits.desc: Loud, lively and impossible for pond fish to ignore.

baits.name: Groundbait
baits.desc: Mashed bread, bran and crushed shell. Draws the everyday fish in numbers and keeps the trophies away. Your luck is ignored while it's on the hook.

baits.name: Bloodworms
baits.desc: Dug from the mud at low tide. Brackish fish go wild.

baits.name: Frozen Sardine
baits.desc: Whole oily sardine for the big open-water hunters.

baits.name: Moonfly Lure
baits.desc: Tied with pale feathers that catch the moon. Works anywhere.

baits.name: Abyss Lantern
baits.desc: A caged, living lanternfish. Calls the deep things up.

baits.name: Siren's Roe
baits.desc: Salt-cured roe from a fish nobody admits to catching.

baits.name: Duellist's Chum
baits.desc: Blood, oil and pier sweepings, mixed by the duellists themselves. Works at any water. Earned on the weekly Duel Ladder, never sold for gold.

baits.name: Salted Cutbait
baits.desc: Crafted. Salt-cured strips of your own catch.

baits.name: Oiled Chum Ball
baits.desc: Crafted. Ground fish bound with oil and spice.

baits.name: Glow Paste
baits.desc: Crafted. Luminous paste that lures things from the dark.

baits.name: Angler's Secret
baits.desc: Crafted. Nobody sells this. Nobody explains it.

ingredients.name: Harbour Spice
ingredients.desc: A secret blend from the dockside stalls.

dive.name: Dive
dive.hint: expect it to plunge, ease off when the sweet spot drops

run.name: Burst run
run.hint: expect long runs, keep the pressure on when the sweet spot climbs

leap.name: Leap
leap.hint: expect it to leap, take up the slack right after

second_wind.name: Second wind
second_wind.hint: expect a rally near the end, the sweet spot narrows and it pulls harder

tiring.name: Tiring zone
tiring.hint: the sweet spot narrows as you wear it down

panic.name: Panic
panic.hint: it thrashes twice as often in the last stretch
